name: act1_get_item
title: Act 1 → hold the Idol of Silvanus
about: Sandbox (family 2): get the druids' Idol of Silvanus into the party's inventory by any means (theft, trade, a fight; the method is reported, never graded).

note.where: The Emerald Grove, out of combat, no dialogue open.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
